title: Elements, Compounds and Mixtures
summary: Everything is built from about 118 elements. Joined together they make compounds; mixed without joining they make mixtures.

ib.note: Links to symbols and formulas, and later the periodic table (Unit 6)

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 8: Nature of Matter: Elements, Compounds and Mixtures
Ch 2: Is Matter Around Us Pure?, section 2.5

objectives: I can define element, compound and mixture, and give examples of each.
I can classify particle diagrams as elements, compounds or mixtures.
I can compare the properties of a mixture with those of the compound made from the same elements.
I can read simple chemical symbols and formulas such as H₂O, CO₂ and NaCl.
misconceptions: A compound is just a mixture of elements.
A compound has the properties of the elements it is made from.
Molecules are always compounds (O₂ is a molecule of an element).
